# Achieve

> Achieve is a developer-friendly HTTP server and HTTP application server for Node.js. It supports JavaScript Servlets, static resources, and application routing.

Achieve invokes an application's exported `servlet(session)` entry points and provides the HTTP server, request processing, and routing environment around them.
